title: Actor-critic, A2C and separate optimization roles

chapters.text: Observe the TD signal. Critic V after step: 2; Actor selected-action probability: 0.5.
Correct the critic. Critic V after step: 2.02; Actor selected-action probability: 0.512.
Use a detached advantage. Critic V after step: 2.05; Actor selected-action probability: 0.525.
Update action probability. Critic V after step: 2.08; Actor selected-action probability: 0.537.
Keep the two roles distinct. Critic V after step: 2.1; Actor selected-action probability: 0.55.
